description: Editorial review queue; not imported to GO Admin. Entries are unpublished, and source dates describe the event or, where noted, a report date.

entries.title: Game Development Workshop #2
entries.description: GO's second game-development workshop was scheduled at Hacklab KIKA. A later interview describes Kosta Markovski sharing the idea for Life of Slaviyan during the workshop, where the group built on it together.

entries.title: Online Global Game Jam site
entries.relationship: GO organized an online site within the wider Global Game Jam.
entries.description: GO organized an online Global Game Jam site from 24 to 28 January 2024. The official site records the dates and lists games submitted at the site.

entries.title: Regional game-development meeting in Skopje
entries.organization: MAGDA and Croatian Game Development Alliance
entries.relationship: Independent organizations represented at a regional meeting with GO.
entries.description: GO representative Ivan Kikerkov attended a regional discussion with representatives of MAGDA and the Croatian Game Development Alliance. CGDA reported on 1 June that the meeting took place the previous day.

entries.title: Regional game jam and educational programme
entries.relationship: Venue for programme activities; the programme involved additional implementation partners.
entries.project: Empowering the Next Generation of Game Developers
entries.description: GO's educational programme combined practical game-development modules with a regional game jam. The GO-hosted jam page reports that six educational modules were completed and lists 11 entries. The jam began on 19 October 2024; sources differ about its end date.

entries.title: Navigator launched for Human Rights Day
entries.organization: Europe House and Macedonian Young Lawyers Association
entries.description: GO's retrospective says the educational game Navigator launched for International Human Rights Day in partnership with Europe House and the Macedonian Young Lawyers Association.

entries.title: Glagolitic VR prototypes and open call reported
entries.relationship: Project initiator and collaborator with GO.
entries.description: GO reported functional Glagolitic-script VR prototypes and opened a call for creators to contribute to a further phase of the project initiated by Prof. Laze Tripkov with GO. This date is the article publication date; confirm current status before publication.

entries.title: GO reports platform and community work
entries.description: A GO community update reported the platform launch, early community-made assets and educational and game-jam activities. The date is the report date, not a verified launch date. The article title and its publication metadata give different years and need review.

entries.title: Consolidated Statute adopted
entries.description: The consolidated GO Statute states that it was adopted at an assembly on 20 August 2025. It sets out the association's objectives and governance. This date is not claimed as the date of the earlier initiative or original registration.

entries.title: Battle Toynks core-loop update
entries.description: GO's development log reported an internally playable core loop for Battle Toynks, including tank movement, shooting, objectives and a win condition. The project was in development at the time; confirm current status before publication.

entries.title: Passion to Profession Game Jam
entries.relationship: Organizers; GO and Base42 collaborated, and GO hosted the itch.io page.
entries.description: The Passion to Profession Game Jam ran from 1 to 26 December 2025 and received seven entries. MUGI and Semos Education organized it in collaboration with GO and Base42.

entries.title: Unwelcome Guests demo reported
entries.relationship: Independent developer conceived within the GO community; DOSMan Games is credited as publisher.
entries.description: GO reported that PrintNPlay's free Unwelcome Guests demo was available on Steam. The date is the article's publication date, not a verified Steam release date.

entries.title: Fourth Game Dev Meetup recap
entries.description: GO reported that its fourth Game Dev Meetup brought creators together at Base42 to play locally developed games and exchange feedback. The date is the report date; verify the actual meetup date before publication.
